stem: A species is classified into one of three domains.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Two of the domains contain only prokaryotic species.

With reference to the two prokaryotic domains, describe the features used to classify prokaryotic species into two different domains.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Tigers are large mammals that live in many parts of Asia.
